children: DoubleZero expects to launch Edge for Builders on its mainnet in Q4 2026. The product will allow applications and exchanges to publish their own data feeds over the network.

Edge for Builders opens new revenue channels by allowing third-party exchanges to publish data feeds on the protocol. It also supports usage-based burning of the 2Z token, linking token burns to activity on the network.

title: DoubleZero: Edge for Builders is set for mainnet launch - Q4 2026
